faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Didn't find what you were looking for? Reach out after creating your account.

what.question: What is Vertex?
what.answer: Vertex is a complete platform that brings CRM, calendar, finance, inventory and an AI assistant together in one place. The assistant understands your business context and executes real tasks — schedules, billing, organization — not just answers questions.

trial.question: How can I try it before paying?
trial.answer: When you create your account you get 150 free credits to try every feature in Vertex. No credit card required to get started. These credits are one-time: when they run out, AI features pause until you pick a paid plan. CRM, calendar, finance and inventory keep working normally even after the free credits are used up.

credits.question: How do credits work?
credits.answer: Each plan includes a fixed monthly amount of credits. They are consumed as you use AI: assistant conversations, agent runs, web searches and image generation. Simple operations consume very few credits, and most day-to-day work (records, calendar, finance) consumes none.

noCreditsLeft.question: What happens if I run out of credits?
noCreditsLeft.answer: Non-AI features (CRM, calendar, finance, inventory) keep working normally. Only AI-powered actions pause until your plan's next renewal. On a paid plan you can also buy one-off credit packs anytime to top up without waiting for the next cycle.

changePlan.question: Can I change plans whenever I want?
changePlan.answer: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and downgrades apply on the next billing cycle. You never lose data when switching plans — only the limits of the new plan take over.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: You are only charged when you pick a paid plan. Billing is monthly with a fixed fee, automatic renewal, and AI credits are refreshed at the start of every cycle. You can cancel anytime directly from the platform.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. Cancellation is immediate with no fees. You keep access to your plan until the end of the paid period and the subscription ends after that.

team.question: Can I invite my team?
team.answer: Yes, starting on the Starter plan. Every collaborator gets their own login with granular permissions — you decide who can see customers, edit services, access finance and so on.

security.question: Is my data safe?
security.answer: Your data is isolated per account, protected by robust authentication and stored encrypted. Only you and the collaborators you invite have access to your workspace.

agents.question: How do autonomous agents work?
agents.answer: Agents are AI flows that run scheduled tasks on their own — send invoices on the due date, generate weekly reports, follow up on inactive customers. Set it up once and they keep running in the background, even when you're offline.
